sidebar.$description: Sidebar rail widths. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group.

width.$description: Thickness of the selected-item indicator bar at the inline start of an active menu item — the part of the Qeet navigation signature that carries selection at 3:1 when the tint alone would not. Owned here because it is a sidebar decision with no semantic counterpart; it stays fixed across densities so the bar reads the same at every row height.
